en: The Eighth Adhyāya in the Seventh Aṣṭaka.
Sūktas of the Tenth Maṇḍala.
41. The forty-first sūkta, beginning ⟦ಸಮಾನಮು ತ್ಯಂ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta.
42. The forty-second sūkta, beginning ⟦ಅಸ್ತೇವ⟧
43. The forty-third sūkta, beginning ⟦ಅಚ್ಛಾಮ ಇಂದ್ರಂ⟧
Explanation of the meaning of the word ⟦ಶ್ವಘ್ನೀ⟧, etc.
44. The forty-fourth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಆ ಯಾತ್ವಿಂದ್ರಃ⟧
45. The forty-fifth sūkta, beginning ⟦ದಿವಸ್ಪರಿ⟧
The three kinds of Agni.
The origin of Agni in the heavenly world.
Praise of the lightning-Agni of the atmosphere.
The greatness of the earthly Agni.
The various Agnis: Jātavedas, Vaiśvānara, Draviṇodas, etc.
Description of the great qualities of Agni, etc.
Discussion of the deathlessness of Agni, etc.
Here ends the Eighth Adhyāya in the Seventh Aṣṭaka.
The First Adhyāya in the Eighth Aṣṭaka.
46. The forty-sixth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಪ್ರ ಹೋತಾ ಜಾತಃ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta—the greatness of the sūktas seen by the seer Vatsapri.
How Bhṛgu and other seers found Agni.
How Mātariśvan brought Agni from the atmosphere.
How Bṛhaspati found Agni.
The relation between the Aṅgirasa seers and Agni.
Discussion of matters concerning Trita Āptya.
47. The forty-seventh sūkta, beginning ⟦ಜಗೃಭ್ಮಾ ತೇ⟧
48. The forty-eighth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಅಹಂ ಭುವಂ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta—why Indra is called Mahānindra.
The Nirukta of the Ṛk ⟦ಅಭೀ ೩ ದಂ⟧.
Explanation of the meaning of the word ⟦ಖಲ⟧.
The formation of the words ⟦ಏಕ⟧, ⟦ದ್ವಾ⟧, ⟦ತ್ರಯಃ⟧, ⟦ಚತುರ್ಥ⟧, etc.
49. The forty-ninth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಅಹಂ ದಾಂ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta—the daring deeds of Indra—description of the slaying of the asura Vṛtra.
The story of the goddess Prāsahā.
Why Indra has the name Marutvān.
The killing of the rākṣasa Namuci by Indra.
Why Indra has the name Ṛjīṣī.
The killing of the asura Varāha by Indra.
The killing of Viśvarūpa by Indra.
How Indra incurred the guilt of killing a Brāhmaṇa, and the efforts he made to remove it.
The subject of Indra's Vaikuṇṭha.
The subject of Kavi Uśanā.
The subject of Kutsa.
The subject of the asura Śuṣṇa.
Explanation of the meaning of the word ⟦ದಸ್ಯು⟧.
Explanation of the word ⟦ವೇತಸೂನ್⟧.
The subject of Turvaśa and Yadu.
50. The fiftieth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಪ್ರ ವೋ ಮಹೇ⟧
The subject of the oblations (or deities) called Devasuvas.
The subject of the Brahmodya discussed at the sacrifice.
51. The fifty-first sūkta, beginning ⟦ಮಹತ್ತದುಲ್ಪಂ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta.
The deeds of Agni.
How Agni hid in the water.
The conversation between the gods and Agni on this matter.
The account of this matter in the Bṛhaddevatā.
Yāska's explanation of the oblations called Prayājas and Anuyājas.
52. The fifty-second sūkta, beginning ⟦ವಿಶ್ವೇ ದೇವಾಃ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta.
Discussion of the Viśvedevas.
Names of the seers who saw sūktas addressed to the Viśvedevas, and the sūktas.
The deities who are occasionally praised in sūktas addressed to the Viśvedevas.
Discussion of the number of the gods.
53. The fifty-third sūkta, beginning ⟦ಯಮೈಚ್ಛಾಮ⟧
Who the five peoples (pañcajanas) are.
The special application (viniyoga) of the Ṛk ⟦ತಂತುಂ ತನ್ವನ್⟧.
54. The fifty-fourth sūkta, beginning ⟦ತಾಂ ಸು ತೇ⟧
55. The fifty-fifth sūkta, beginning ⟦ದೂರೇ ತನ್ನಾಮ⟧
56. The fifty-sixth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಇದಂ ತ ಏಕಂ⟧
The subject of the threefold debt.
57. The fifty-seventh sūkta, beginning ⟦ಮಾ ಪ್ರ ಗಾಮ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta—the story of the seer Subandhu.
The ancient legend told in the Śāṭyāyana Brāhmaṇa about Subandhu.
58. The fifty-eighth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಯತ್ತೇ ಯಮಂ⟧
59. The fifty-ninth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಪ್ರ ತಾರ್ಯಾಯುಃ⟧
The Nirukta of the Ṛk ⟦ಅಸುನೀತೇ ಪುನಃ⟧.
60. The sixtieth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಆ ಜನಂ⟧
The explanation in the Śāṭyāyana Brāhmaṇa of the Ṛk ⟦ಅಯಂ ಮಾತಾಯಂ⟧.
61. The sixty-first sūkta, beginning ⟦ಇದಮಿತ್ಥಾ ರೌದ್ರಂ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta.
The subject of the seer Nābhānediṣṭha—how Manu gave his sons their shares of the inheritance.
How Prajāpati became enamoured of his own daughter.
The origin of Āditya, Bhṛgu and the Aṅgirases.
Here ends the First Adhyāya in the Eighth Aṣṭaka.
The Second Adhyāya.
62. The sixty-second sūkta, beginning ⟦ಯೇ ಯಜ್ಞೇನ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta.
The formation of the word ⟦ಅಂಗಿರಾಃ⟧.
63. The sixty-third sūkta, beginning ⟦ಪರಾವತಃ⟧
The Nirukta of the Ṛk ⟦ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿರಿದ್ಧಿ⟧.
64. The sixty-fourth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಕಥಾ ದೇವಾನಾಂ⟧
The subject of the deity Narāśaṃsa.
Explanation of the word ⟦ಅದಿತಿ⟧, and the Nirukta of the Ṛk ⟦ದಕ್ಷಸ್ಯ ವಾದಿತೇ⟧.
The names of the seven Soma-guardians, etc.
65. The sixty-fifth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಅಗ್ನಿರಿಂದ್ರೋ ವರುಣಃ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta.
The subject of the deities Mitra, Varuṇa and Aryamā.
66. The sixty-sixth sūkta, beginning ⟦ದೇವಾನ್ ಹುವೇ⟧
67. The sixty-seventh sūkta, beginning ⟦ಇಮಾಂ ಧಿಯಂ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta.
The subject of the deity Bṛhaspati.
How Bṛhaspati brought back the cows of the gods that Vala had carried off.
Why the Aṅgirases are called Varāhas.
68. The sixty-eighth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಉದಪ್ರುತಃ⟧
69. The sixty-ninth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಭದ್ರಾ ಅಗ್ನೇಃ⟧
70. The seventieth sūkta, beginning ⟦ಇಮಾಂ ಮೇ ಅಗ್ನೇ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta—the subject of the Āprī sūktas.
Samiddha (Agni).
Narāśaṃsa.
Iḷā.
Barhis.
The Divine Doors.
Night and Dawn.
The Two Divine Hotṛs.
The three goddesses (Sarasvatī, Iḷā and Bhāratī).
Tvaṣṭṛ.
Vanaspati.
Svāhākṛti.
71. The seventy-first sūkta, beginning ⟦ಬೃಹಸ್ಪತೇ ಪ್ರಥಮಂ⟧
Introduction to the sūkta.
The Nirukta of the Ṛk ⟦ಸಕ್ತುಮಿವ ತಿತಉನಾ⟧.
The Nirukta of the Ṛk ⟦ಉತ ತ್ವಃ ಪಶ್ಯನ್⟧.
The Nirukta of the Ṛk ⟦ಉತ ತ್ವಂ ಸಖ್ಯೇ⟧.
The Nirukta of the Ṛk ⟦ಅಕ್ಷಣ್ವಂತಃ ಕರ್ಣವಂತಃ⟧.
The Nirukta of the Ṛk ⟦ಋಚಾಂ ತ್ವಃ ಪೋಷಮಾಸ್ತೇ⟧.
Here ends the Second Adhyāya in the Eighth Aṣṭaka.
